name: mt-property-transfer-tax-the-sale-immovable
description: Use this skill for the sale of immovable property situated in Malta in 2026, by deed inter vivos. It covers the seller's article 5A final tax on the transfer value (8% general, 10% for property acquired before 2004, 5% within five years, 2% for a declared first home sold within three years, 7% and 12% for inherited or donated property, 5% and 10% for restored property, the Housing Authority lease relief), the own-residence exemption, the remaining exclusions with 7% provisional tax, brokerage, the 85% undervalue rule, and the buyer's duty (5% general, 3.5% for a sole ordinary residence, the first-time buyer exemption on the first EUR 200,000), the 1% provisional duty at promise of sale, the DDT1 and the notary's role. Trigger on sell property Malta, property transfer tax Malta, 8% final tax, capital gains on a house in Malta, inherited property sale Malta, stamp duty Malta, konvenju, DDT1.
